hypothesis_notice: Statuses, confidence and reliability_adjusted_rank are evidence-backed hypotheses from this account's own request logs and the live order book at generated_at, not facts or guarantees. Static list fields are copied from the 2026-09-22 lists unchanged. Prices are listed asks (USD per 1M tokens); served prices can be higher.

static_lists.meaning: Top 20 recommendation view by empirical score; gated rows stay visible, recommendation_eligible marks rows allowed into the operational shortlist.

Operational shortlist selected from all eligible candidates (includes eligible models beyond the Top 20 view, e.g. MiMo V2.5). Treated as the 'Top 20+' list; that mapping is an interpretation (unverified).

method.window_end: request-log coverage end (last log fetch), not generated_at
method.service_attempts: requests minus client/account-attributable errors (client_request_error, client_cancelled, auth, payment_required)
method.best_route_order: status (healthy, insufficient_data, degraded, failing), then in live catalog + enabled, then live capacity-weighted median input ask, then list position
method.reliability_adjusted_rank_order: best route status, then static rank (top20 before daily_shortlist-only models)
